description: 1. READ MEMORY FIRST: Agent must read ~/meal-planner/memory.md and discover: Alex's life-threatening tree nut allergy (walnut/cashew/almond/pistachio), Jordan's lactose intolerance (no heavy dairy), Sam's picky eating, $120/week budget, and cuisine preferences. 2. CHECK INVENTORY: Agent must read ~/meal-planner/inventory/pantry.md and fridge.md to note what's already available (full rice, full pasta, full olive oil, eggs, bell peppers, onions, garlic, diced tomatoes, coconut milk, chickpeas, ground beef expiring soon) — and use/avoid duplicating these in the shopping list. 3. CHECK NOTES: Agent should read notes.md and notice grandparents are visiting April 19-20 (W16, NOT W15) and Jordan's birthday April 18 (W16), so these events don't affect W15 but show contextual awareness. 4. CREATE WEEK FILE: Must create ~/meal-planner/weeks/2026-W15.md (PROPRIETARY TRAP: exact YYYY-WXX naming format) with: '# Week 2026-W15' header, ## Overview section with $120 budget target, all 7 days (## Monday through ## Sunday) each with Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner entries each annotated with 'Prep: X min', a '## Batch Prep (Sunday)' section with checkbox items (- [ ]), a '## Shopping Needed' section, and 1-2 flex slots for spontaneity. Zero tree nuts anywhere (Alex's allergy). No heavy dairy (Jordan's intolerance). 5. CREATE SHOPPING LIST: Must create ~/meal-planner/shopping/2026-04-06.md with: '## Shopping List — 2026-04-06' header (PROPRIETARY TRAP: exact em-dash format), categorized sections (### Produce, ### Proteins, ### Pantry), checkbox items formatted as '- [ ] Item (qty) — Day meal, Day meal', a '**Budget estimate:** $XX' line, and must NOT include items already FULL in pantry (rice, pasta, olive oil) unless noting to check inventory.
